about.title: Getting paid right should not be guesswork
about.subtitle: My Pay is a simple way to log your shifts, see what you should earn after tax, and check it against what actually lands in your account.

problem.title: Pay slips rarely match what you expect
problem.body: Shifts, breaks, overnight hours and tax add up fast. When the money arrives short, it is hard to prove why.

solution.title: Three steps, no spreadsheets
solution.body: Log once, and My Pay does the maths and keeps the record for you.

1.title: Log your shifts
1.body: Add start, finish and break times for each day you work.

2.title: See your pay
2.body: Pay and tax for the fortnight are worked out as you go.

3.title: Check it
3.body: Enter what you were paid and see the difference straight away.

simple.title: Simple
simple.body: Only what you need to track your pay.

private.title: Private

accurate.title: Accurate
